name: pulse
description: Pulse — the Strapi team's mention-sentiment tracker (Strapi 5 + Next.js 16)

scripts.setup: npm install && node copy-env.mjs apps/cms && node copy-env.mjs apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n cms,web -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npx wait-on http://localhost:1337/_health && npm run frontend"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n cms,web -c blue,magenta "PULSE_SEED_DEMO=true npm run backend" "npx wait-on http://localhost:1337/_health && npm run frontend"
scripts.db:import: cd apps/cms && npx strapi import -f ../../seed-data.tar.gz --force --exclude config
